title: Toy Telephone Sets Recalled by Montgomery Ward
tell: All units are recalled. The ivory sets have the name Mehanotehnika printed on the bottom of each phone.

title: Armour Replaces Safety Caps On Thyroid Tablets
tell: This announcement involves a voluntary cap replacement program for prescription thyroid tablets, not a product recall.

product: Riviton Sets Recalled by Parker Brothers
title: Riviton Sets Recalled by Parker Brothers
tell: All units of the Riviton toy construction sets are recalled.

product: Mattel Colonial Viper, Scarab, Stellar Probe; Cylon Raider Battlestar Galactica space vehicles
title: Mattel Puts Safety Labels On Toys
tell: Check the model number on the toy or packaging to see if it matches the recalled space vehicles.

product: Citation Power Cleaning Equipment portable air tanks
title: Warning Issued On Portable Air Tanks
tell: Red tanks are labeled Citation Power Cleaning Equipment, yellow tanks are Camel Big Airy No. 5510, and blue tanks are General Service Line No. 9-774 Portable Air Tank.

title: Thermostat "Activator" Units Recalled
tell: Check the model number FS-5 and date codes 396 through 526, 017 through 327, 437 through 527, and 018 through 218 on the back of the Activator unit, and inspect for a brown resistor.

title: Amana Freezers
tell: Check the model and serial number on the serial plate located behind the removable black grille at the lower front of the unit. Recalled models are SR17, SR19, SR22, SR25, SD19, SD22, and SD25 with serial numbers beginn…

title: Chain Guard Kit for Bicycle Offerred by Columbia
tell: All units are not recalled; affected are Miami 24-inch and Gold Crest 26-inch 3-speed racers matching the specified model numbers and manufactured between November 13, 1976, and August 13, 1978.

title: Smoke Detectors Recalled by BRK Electronics
tell: All units in the SS749 series produced from March 1974 to September 26, 1975 are recalled.

product: Whirlwind Torch Kit CleanBurn Fuel Cylinders
title: Fuel Cylinders Recalled
tell: Recalled units are yellow CleanBurn fuel cylinders, model CB-1000, manufactured from June 1977 to April 1978.

title: Air Conditioners Recalled
tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the model number 51GA0661 or 51GB0661 found on a metallic plate behind the unit's decorative front grille.

product: Miti-Mite portable immersible electric water heaters
title: Portable Water Heaters Recalled
tell: All units are recalled. The heaters do not bear a model number, but can be identified by the label Miti-Mite embossed on top.

title: J.C. Penney Conducts Repair Program For Bench Grinders
tell: The repair program applies only to model 4030 grinders purchased after June 1973 which are not imprinted with a three-digit date code on the nameplate.

title: Consumers Urged To Inspect Edger/Trimmer Garden Tools
tell: Check for model number WWH 2052A on the warning label on the metal shaft and on a name plate on top of the motor housing.

title: Portable Electric Fans Recalled
tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the bottom of the base for the model number and a 5-digit date code ending in 3 or 4.

title: J.C. Penney Alerts Consumers To Potential Bike Defect
tell: Check the outside of the left, rear, metal axle plate for specific numbers and catalog numbers.

title: Bench Grinders Repaired by McGraw-Edison
tell: Check the brand and model number on the nameplate; units with specific date codes or lacking date codes as described in the notice are involved unless an orange inspection sticker is present.

product: Curious George,Easter Chick,ChickADee,Puppy Love,Scooby-Doo stuffed toys
title: Stuffed Toys Recalled by Knickerbocker
tell: You can identify the recalled toys by the numbers K-20, K-21, K-22, K-23, K-25, and K-32 imprinted on a tag affixed to the toy's seam.

title: Sweat Shirts Recalled By Huk-A-Poo
tell: You can identify the recalled sweatshirts by the number RN34104 and the words Made in Hong Kong on the label, along with specific style numbers on the hang tags.

product: Black And Decker Cord Adapters Recalled
title: Black And Decker Cord Adapters Recalled
tell: You can tell the recalled orange adapters by the number 86-210 molded on the outside surface and any metal showing through the molded material.

title: Sears Stepladders Recalled
tell: You can identify the recalled ladders by their green feet and model number 133.42435 or stock number 42435 located on the upper end of the side rail.

title: Sewing Machine Quality Assurance Program Announced
tell: Recalled units have Type 213 black foot pedals stamped on the bottom, lacking a blue "T".

product: Repair Program Announced For Baby Car Seat/Stroller
title: Repair Program Announced For Baby Car Seat/Stroller
tell: Affected kits manufactured before March 14, 1977 lack two hinged metal braces riveted at right angles to the top of the stroller frame seat support reinforcing the seat from beneath.

title: Coast King Bicycle Recall
tell: All units are not recalled; only the royal blue men's 27-inch 10-speed model C8798T is affected, with the model number located on the left rear axle plate.

product: Great American Frying Machine mini electric deep fryers
title: CPSC Announces Replacement/Refitting Program For Electric Deep Fryers
tell: Model 7000A fryers are excluded. The recalled units are model 7000 in two styles: one with two white plastic handles and three black legs, and another with a black plastic circular base and a single bucket-type handle.

title: Bicycle Recall Announced
tell: You can identify a recalled bicycle by checking the identification number located on the left rear axle plate against the listed affected model numbers.

title: Recall Of Electric Paint Removers
tell: Check the model number imprinted on the plastic handle or metal housing for Red Devil model 3401 or Sears model 44791 purchased between May 1 and October 31, 1977.

product: Sperry Remington women's rechargeable electric shavers
title: Women's Shavers Repaired by Sperry Remington
tell: Check the base plate on the bottom of the shaver for model numbers 3B2L or 6B2L that do not contain a large R.

product: GAP San Francisco Tea Party sweatshirts
title: Ladies' Sweatshirts With "Gap" Label Recalled
tell: You can tell by the sewn-in black label at the back of the neck saying GAP in light gray stitching or San Francisco Tea Party, with a Made in Hong Kong label.

title: Electric Hot Pot Recall
tell: All units of these white ceramic hot pots are recalled; the bottom is imprinted with 120V-350W JAPAN and the packaging is marked with the Jack Eckerd Corporation name.

title: Baby Crib Poses Potential Danger To Infants
tell: You can tell by checking the model numbers 5126-505 and 5621-505 in yellow or 5225-505 in white, printed on adhesive labels on the headboards below mattress level.

product: Magic Curl Professional, hand-held Curling Irons
title: Recall Of Hand-Held Curling Irons
tell: You can identify the recalled unit by its yellow swivel handle and chrome-coated heating element, with two stickers on the handle including the Magic Curl name, whereas the white-handled model 100 is not recalled.

title: Sump Pumps Repaired
tell: Recalled pumps have solid black plastic float switches positioned on top of the pump motor. Pumps with bright metal float switches are not affected.

title: Gas Valves Prompt Warning
tell: All units are not recalled; suspect valves have the number 3/4 or 1/2 stamped on the side and the word Taiwan on the washer.

product: Fast Heat portable immersible electric water heaters
title: G.L. Electric Flasheat Water Heaters warning
tell: You can identify the recalled units by model numbers 401, 501, and 101, featuring either a cylindrical perforated metal case or two round, flat porcelain shells.

title: Flammable Sweatshirts Recalled
tell: Look for the sewn-in label at the back of the neck saying SAN FRANCISCO TEA PARTY with a cablecar and Made in Hong Kong, sold from October 1977.

title: Baseball Pitching Machines Warning
tell: The recall applies to unguarded automatic baseball pitching machines labeled Dudley or Commercial Mechanisms manufactured between 1956 and 1975.

title: Water Wiggle Toy Recalled by Wham-O
tell: All units of the Water Wiggle toy are recalled.

product: Okla Homer Smith full-sized baby cribs
title: Crib Teething Rails Recalled by Okla Homer Smith Furniture
tell: Check for the label on the inside of the headboard near the bottom and a numerical manufacturing date from June 1976 through December 1976 ink-stamped underneath the headboard.

title: Hot Pots Recalled by Nevco
tell: All units are recalled; the box is marked with the Nevco name, and the bottom of each unit is imprinted with the words 120V-350W JAPAN.

title: Pellet Pistols Repaired by Crosman Arms
tell: Models produced after January 1978 are not affected and are identified by an R stamped on the pistol and on the outside of the carton.

title: Baby Cribs Modified by Bassett
tell: Check the model number and color printed on the adhesive label affixed to the headboard below the mattress to identify affected cribs.

title: Nobility Coffeemakers Recalled
tell: All units are recalled. The name NOBILITY is on the front, and the base metal plate is etched with UL LISTED 4293, MADE IN SINGAPORE, DO NOT IMMERSE IN WATER, and E57635 MODEL 232.

product: Le Gran Imports Christmas light replacement bulbs
title: Decorative Christmas Light Bulbs Recalled
tell: Check the package for Item No. LC-7005P size 7 l/2, the words Christmas Lamps, and Le Gran Imports, and inspect the bulbs for a thin strand of wire protruding from the base.

product: Scuba Regulators Replaced by Parkway Fabricators
title: Scuba Regulators Replaced by Parkway Fabricators
tell: Check for the Poseidon brand on the purge button and serial numbers in the ranges 15024 through 16523 and 18050 through 18549 located on the first stage.

title: Christmas Light Sets Recalled by New York Merchandise
tell: Examine the inside of each socket; if both metal electrical contacts are in the vertical position instead of one horizontal and one vertical, the set is defective.

title: Decorative Christmas Light Bulbs Recalled
tell: Check the package for Item No. LC-9004 size 9 l/4 or Item No. LC-7004 size 7 l/2 with the letters MRI.

title: Refrigerator Repaired by White-Westinghouse
tell: Check the serial plate on the lower left-front corner inside the door for the listed model numbers and serial numbers starting with RUD, RUE, RUF, RUG, RUH, RUJ, RUK, RUL, or RTG.

title: Refrigerator Repaired by Magic Chef
tell: Affected units are model FB 148 manufactured between Sept. 9 and Nov. 11, 1977, with serial numbers starting with RUH, RUJ, RUK, and RUL found on the serial plate on the lower left-front corner.

title: Refrigerator repaired by Kelvinator
tell: You can identify recalled units by model number TPX140MN and a 10-digit serial number beginning with 107, located on the serial plate on the lower left-front corner when the door is open.

title: Repair Of Defective Baby Strollers Announced
tell: You can identify the recalled strollers by a 4-digit code number running from 7010 through 7056 stamped on the strap located beneath the stroller seat.

title: Scuba Equipment Recalled
tell: All U.S. Divers scuba regulators sold after December 1, 1976, are recalled. The model name and U.S. Divers appear on the product on the purge button.

product: ABC Educational Blocks wooden toy alphabet block sets
title: Wooden Toy Alphabet Blocks Recalled
tell: All units of this product are recalled; you can identify them by the cardboard label stapled at the top of the plastic bag stating ABC Educational Blocks.
